rows.TEXT: In her youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. She then became sovereign of her realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.

Sir Patrick of the Empire 
"My Lord, our mystics have uncovered some very interesting information. We have learned that on the twenty fifth day of this month, the owner of Khazan Keep will be awarded a powerful ally!"

Azhrial the Wicked 
"Oh great leader, we have tortured an elf mystic and gained some valuable information. The city of Khazan Keep is enchanted and on the twenty fifth day of the month, its owner will be granted a fearsome beast!"

Zombie 
"The graveyards ssspeak to me of an enchantment. On the twenty fifffth day the enchanted city Khazan Keep will bessssstow upon the owner the dragon Lazor. The dragon will be loyal to the owner for as long as it ssshall live."

Clodius the Fighter 
"Behold master! The enchantment has proven itself to be true. The beast Lazor is ours to command!"

Skeleton 
"Finally we have rid Necropolis of the Human wassste and regained control of our most sinissster weapon - the Mantis Spider!"

Ghost 
"Khazan Keep is too risssky. Our enemies are already there and our ssservants are under attack elsssewhere. Our city of Necropolisss has been taken over by invadersss."

Marxis the Acolyte 
"This rabid wolf has been mutilating bear cubs. Perhaps if we slay the wolf, our animal trainers will be able to tame the bears for our cause."

Berzerker 
"Enough talk! On with the slaughter!

Gregory 
"In the name of order, in the name of humanity we will liberate this land!"

Wizard 
"I shall not go down without a fight."

Belle, the Angel of Runia 
"I need your help! My city Runia has been taken over by witch hunters! How can they think me a witch, when I am sent from the very God they worship?  Runia is just south of here, please return me to my people."

Belle 
"I will remain here while you deal with the vicious witch hunters. Teach them that they cannot simply conquer and spread their hatred to the people. Remove them from power and I will be inclined to reward you for your troubles."

Darius the Dark Angel 
"Belle was a fool to ask for your help. Now that the curse has been lifted I am free! As for your reward little pawn. I shall reward you with savagery!"

Artremis  
"Why do you attack us? We are loyal to the Empire! Since the arrival of the Ice-Mar the republic has become unstable. Elves, giants, dwarves and dragons are on the rampage and now we are assaulted by our brothers? What madness is this?"

Artremis the Witch Hunter 
"You may have taken the city from us, but you also inherit its curse. Very few hold Runia for long!"

Bryshaughn of the Ice-Mar 
"You may control the Keep, but you will never unlock its secret!"

Gorgoh of the Ice-Mar 
"What have you done??? Now that we've no control over Blaze and his lot, they will ravage Rheal without purpose! We'll soon see if you are ready to face your mistake!"
"The Necropolis belongs to Gryshana. I was hoping the bodies of your friends strewn about the floor would convince you to leave."

Bryshanus of the Ice-Mar. 
"We are the only true stabilizing force in Rheal! Our dragons enforce our will and our brethren are wealthier than you can imagine. Make no mistake, this land will be ours..."
I have potent spells at a reasonble price.

Markus  
"We have been sent to head off the Ice-Mar uprising and drive the pagan Elves back into their forest homes. Know that you have prevented our mission and you have only brought suffering to your people."
Everything I possess is for sale.

Orc  
"My axe will strike you down."
How may I help you stranger?

Finno-Ugr of the Ice-Mar 
"For too long our way of life has suffered because of you! Our people live in fear because of your selfish quest for power. A new age is coming and only the Ice-Mar will live to see it!"
My spells can help you in your quest.

Brysmor of the Ice-Mar. 
"Foolish people, you should have stayed away! Now you are nothing more than food for the bears..."
The more gold you give the stronger I will make you.

Imperial Knight 
"We have been able to gather some information about the Ice-Mar. They apparently were once of the Mountain Clans but split away to become an independant tribe.  They are said to be as fierce and unpredictable as the northern weather."

Baroness 
"The weather in Northern Rheal  is very volatile and ice storms have been known to appear at a moment's notice. You will bring us resources from these dangerous lands regardless of the cost."

Skeleton 
"The Iccce-Mar have great hatred in their hearts. They have become as cold inssside as the Mountains that they live in. Be warned the northern part of Rheal is covered in iccce and the storms are horribly violent."

Frigidalis of the Ice-Mar. 
"You have done enough to hurt these lands. You drove us to this! Now under the rule of the Ice-Mar, Rheal will never be tainted again!"

Hu' Mujib the Servant 
"The enchantment hasss proven true. Behold the mighty Lazzzzor!"

Hazlial the Destroyer 
"Our Legions shall reap the rewards of Khazan Keep. With Lazor under our command,  we shall set this world ablaze!"

Hu'Lar the Insane. 
"While disssmembering a local, he ranted about Sysolos the dragon,  destroyer of  hisss city. I enjoyed hearing that his people joined Mortisss, but sssadly he  bled to death after mentioning that the beassst swallowed an artifact."

Brumalic of the Ice-Mar 
"Turn back, you pose no threat to the Ice-Mar! Ice-water fills our veins, yet fire burns within us. Do not anger us any further."

Mystolos of the Gyrshonas Elves. 
" With great pain I have seen our people turn to the Ice-Mar for help. With the promise of gold, land, and power, the Ice-Mar have bought the souls of our people. Alas, I am too old to interefere."

Ice-Mar Soldier 
"We are the Ice-Mar and our will in Rheal is the law!"

Ice-Mar Soldier 
"By entering our land, you have forsaken your rights and it is only time before we are your new masters. Surrender now and you will not be tortured...much."

Ice-Mar Rock Giant 
"Little creature your people have been warned to leave this place. Leave now and forever or you shall be buried by my hand."

Vejorn  
"Great Ragnarok how is it that you have made it here? No matter by not leaving this place you have condemned yourself to a cold grave."
